description: Anuh Pharma Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of bulk drugs and chemicals in India. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients, including macrolides, anti-TB, anti-malarial, anti-hypertension, expectorant, anti-diabetics, anti-bacterial, anti-gout, anti asthmatics, quinolones, anti biotic, anti platelet, anti-histamines, and intermediates; and corticosteroids, including anti-inflammatory, immunosuppressant, anti-pruritic, and anti-mitotic. The company also develops products, such as anticoagulant, antagonist, anti convulsants, anty-ulcerative, anty-ulcerative, anticholinergics, anti-anemic, antidepressant, and mucolytic agents. It also exports its products. Anuh Pharma Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
